summary_for_children: At-Takwir describes great changes of the Last Day in words, and swears by the dawn as it breathes.
environment_concept: Late night. Stars run low and slip below the horizon, mirrored in a still pool (81:15-16); a dark grove holds the night as it closes in (81:17); and at the end of the path a dawn glow rises while a soft breeze moves the grass, the dawn as it breathes (81:18). The events of 81:1-14 are not pictured. No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: A still star pool, a dark grove, a dawn glow with swaying grasses.
